statement: The selected Majestic/Fullhan stack can establish reproducible FH8626V100 VI on this camera.
next_test: Pin the exact candidate and prove VI before enabling later media/ISP gates.

statement: After VI is stable, the selected Majestic candidate can establish VENC and sustained RTSP on FH8626V100.
next_test: Validate VI -> VENC -> sustained RTSP as separate gates.

statement: The retained FH8626/FH8852-family ISP path can provide acceptable color, exposure and day/night behavior under Majestic.
next_test: Evaluate only after the base media path is stable.

statement: The accepted /dev/fh_pwm motor backend can be integrated with the final control/API/autotracking path without changing the low-level board contract.
next_test: Perform higher-level calibration and live autotracking acceptance when product integration reaches PTZ.

statement: The hardware-proven RTX microphone/speaker path can be integrated into the selected product streamer/control path with stable capture, playback and required two-way-audio behavior.
next_test: Validate streamer/control integration after the base media path is stable.
